theme_strategy: Light mode is mandatory per user request ('branco com detalhes laranja'). The design should feel like a high-end, clean ERP. Avoid dark mode unless explicitly toggled, as light mode with high contrast ensures maximum legibility for dense tables.

headings.family: Cabinet Grotesk, General Sans, or Outfit
headings.usage: Use for the Dashboard greeting (e.g., 'Olá, João'), page titles, and major section headers. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

body.usage: General UI text, labels, and paragraph copy. Optimizes for dense data readability.

mono.family: IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono
mono.usage: CRITICAL: Must be used for all numeric columns in tables (Código, Quantidade, Valor, Desconto, Total). Always apply 'tabular-nums' utility class to ensure decimal points align perfectly.

brand.usage: Use as an accent (detalhes laranja) for primary CTAs, active states, focus rings, and active sidebar links. Do NOT flood the screen with orange.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: High-Density Cardless UI. Use 1px solid borders (#E4E4E7) to define areas instead of heavy shadows. If shadows are used, use 'shadow-sm' only.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky top header containing the greeting. backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/85. Must have a 1px border-b to separate from content.
visual_enhancers.focus_states: CRITICAL for keyboard navigation. All inputs and active table rows in the Quote Builder must have a crisp 'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F05D23] focus:outline-none'.

layouts.global: Sidebar navigation (collapsible on desktop, drawer on mobile) + Top sticky header. The top header MUST contain the greeting 'Olá, [Nome]', current date, location, and time.
layouts.density: High Density Grid (Mode B). Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize all available screen space. Forms should use responsive CSS grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
layouts.mobile_strategy: Never truncate table information. On mobile, transform table rows into stacked cards to prevent horizontal scrolling or missing data.
layouts.quote_builder_table: Must function like an Excel sheet. Direct inline editing. Focus moves to the next row automatically when 'Enter' is pressed. Columns: Código (searchable), Descrição, Quantidade, Valor, Desconto (%), Valor Líquido.

components.general: Use shadcn/ui primitives adapted for React.js (NOT .tsx).
components.sidebar: Clean, icon-left aligned links. Active link has an orange left border (border-l-4 border-[#F05D23]) and orange icon.
components.table: Dense padding (px-3 py-2). Use 'border-b border-border' for rows. Row hover state should be 'hover:bg-zinc-50'.
components.inputs: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md max). Must have clear active/focus states.
components.pdf_generator: Use 'jspdf' and 'jspdf-autotable' or '@react-pdf/renderer' to generate professional quotes. Must include Company Header, CNPJ, Client Data, and the exact table layout.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle hover states on table rows and buttons (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.navigation: Smooth sliding transitions for mobile drawer.
motion.restrictions: Do not use heavy entrance animations on tables. Data must load instantly without stuttering.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the #F05D23 orange button meets 3:1 minimum contrast. If not, use bold weight to increase legibility.
accessibility.keyboard: The 'Orçamento' table MUST be fully navigable by keyboard (Tab to move horizontally, Enter to add row/move down).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-product-btn').

login_background.description: Minimalist modern architecture with an orange accent line. Perfect for the left/right split panel on the login screen to reinforce the brand identity before the user even logs in.

empty_state.description: Clean, professional light workspace. Use softly faded (opacity-20) in the background of empty states when no clients or quotes exist yet.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building 'Gestor360' - a professional ERP/SaaS dashboard.
File extension rule: You are working in a JavaScript codebase (.js, .jsx). DO NOT generate TypeScript (.ts, .tsx) files.

Color constraint: The user requested 'branco com detalhes laranja'. Do not use heavy colored backgrounds, generic tailwind blue, or excessive gradients. UI must be primarily white/light-gray with strategic orange (#F05D23) for CTAs and focus states.
Component rule: Use shadcn/ui components but ensure they are implemented in plain JS. If a component isn't available, build a clean, accessible HTML/Tailwind alternative.

Quote Builder UX (CRITICAL): The 'Orçamento' page is not just a form. It must be an inline-editable grid/table where pressing 'Enter' adds a new line automatically. This is for fast data entry by sales reps.
PDF functionality: Orçamentos and Vendas must generate a polished PDF. Treat the PDF layout as carefully as the web layout (Header, Client Info, Table, Totals).
Responsiveness (CRITICAL): On mobile, do not truncate table data or use horizontal scrollbars blindly. Reflow table rows into vertical stacked cards where the label and value are side-by-side.
Header requirement: The top header must dynamically show 'Olá, [Nome]', current date, location, and time as requested.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for elements that overlay content (dropdowns, modals, sticky headers). Always use solid or blurred backgrounds.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, input, and interactive element.
